events.name: page_view
events.purpose: Count page loads by route without creating a visitor or session identifier.

events.name: guide_view
events.purpose: Count question-guide page loads by route.

events.name: outbound_click
events.purpose: Count clicks to non-product external references; store a short allowlisted key, not the destination URL.

events.name: product_link_click
events.purpose: Count clicks on explicitly marked, validated product links; no such links are active until the verification gate passes.

events.name: reported_order
events.purpose: Record aggregate order counts imported from an authorized Associates report; browsers cannot submit this event.

note: The hosting provider or network may independently process request metadata. Aggregate files require an operator-defined retention and backup policy.
